source_facts.webhook: POST /webhooks/{controllerID}, outside /api/v1 and administrative bearer middleware; preserve original GitHub event/delivery/target-type/signature headers and raw body
source_facts.repository_identity: GET /api/v1/repositories/{repositoryUUID} returns id, owner, name; UUID differs from GitHub numeric repository ID; verify mapping before pool mutation

create_pool.template_id: optional unsigned JSON integer (*uint), never string/UUID
create_pool.tags: array of strings in request; array of Tag{id,name} in response
create_pool.runner_bootstrap_timeout: minutes; round allocation seconds + bootstrap minutes + margin seconds upward

source_facts.empty_pool: Pool.Instances has omitempty; missing instances in successful Pool DTO is normal when empty, not an outage by itself
source_facts.pool_instances: GET /api/v1/pools/{poolID}/instances supplies explicit inventory; pending/live records and local outstanding operations block drain/delete

bootstrap_labels.non_jit: runner/pool/pool.go:getLabelsForInstance appends exact runner-controller-id=<controller UUID> and runner-pool-id=<pool UUID> to pool tags; Outrider permits its one exact request token plus only those matching internal labels
bootstrap_labels.jit: AddRunner supplies the same complete labels to GetEntityJITConfig; addInstanceToProvider populates BootstrapInstance.Labels only when !hasJITConfig. A real JIT Create normally has empty Labels, and providers must ignore that field when JIT is enabled.
bootstrap_labels.admission: Accept empty Labels for a verified enabled JIT snapshot/controller/pool; preserve the empty field. Nonempty labels must still match the exact request token and only matching GARM internal labels. Do not require a fabricated token label in JIT BootstrapInstance.

external_wrapper_v010.create: GARM_POOL_ID supplied; complete BootstrapInstance (including ExtraSpecs snapshot metadata) serialized on stdin. GARM_POOL_EXTRASPECS environment variable is absent. Normalize snapshot routing from bootstrap for v0.1.0; reject conflicting snapshot IDs if both interface metadata sources are supplied.
external_wrapper_v010.get_start_stop_delete: GARM_INSTANCE_ID supplied; GARM_POOL_ID absent. Resolve immutable child controller/pool from the owned journal allocation. An optionally supplied mismatching pool must not reroute the allocation.
external_wrapper_v010.remove_all: GARM_CONTROLLER_ID supplied; neither pool ID nor instance ID supplied. Enumerate owned allocations for this controller; never invoke child no-op RemoveAll.

out_rider_rules: Reconcile exact singleton atomic user tag, provider, repository, platform, immutable snapshot and bounded pool settings before enable
Persist intent before dispatch, snapshot before enable, then forward original signed body
Reconcile uncertain remote pool creation before another create; duplicate matches remain unresolved
Terminal/expired requests cannot be re-enabled by older queued deliveries; disable and verify zero instances/operations before delete
qualification_limit: Source and synthetic HTTP contracts only; no actual GARM REST/controller instance run.
